name: Next Launch

sources.title: Next Launch homepage — daily 'Top Projects Launching Today' board
Pricing — Free vs Premium $9/launch vs SEO Growth Package $149–199

conditions: Free Launch gets standard queue + homepage feature, but a dofollow backlink only if BOTH: (1) top-3 daily ranking AND (2) their badge displayed on your site
5 free slots available daily; up to 180-day scheduling window
requirements: Sign in/sign up required; submit at /projects/submit
All launches go live at 8:00 AM UTC in daily batches
preparation: Project name, URL, tagline, long description (board entries show full paragraphs), logo, categories
Badge on your site if you want the free-tier dofollow to be possible
Plan: Free $0 / Premium $9 per launch (skip queue, guaranteed dofollow, 10 premium slots daily) / SEO Growth Package $149–199 (dedicated '[Product] review' SEO article + premium launch)
workflow: Choose Free or Premium and pick a launch date within the window
Free listings wait in the standard queue for a daily 8:00 AM UTC slot
During launch day, community voting decides top-3 ranking
watchFor: Free-tier dofollow requires BOTH top-3 ranking AND the badge — worst-case you give them a badge and get a nofollow link
Premium is $9 per launch, not per product permanently
SEO Growth Package is marked 'Coming Soon' with $149 struck to $199 — pricing/availability unstable
Site is 'Powered by Open Launch' — same engine family as launchvault.dev/prolaunch.net, expect identical mechanics and shared template
countsAsLive: Product appears in 'Top Projects Launching Today' on nextlaunch.io at 8:00 AM UTC on the scheduled date with its own listing page
unknowns: Whether free listings without top-3 still keep a nofollow link permanently
